description: Source code for OAuth API endpoints in Mattermost, including OAuth app management, dynamic client registration (DCR), and related handlers.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Main API struct for handling OAuth-related routes and handlers.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Context object providing request-specific data and methods for handling OAuth API requests.

methods.name: InitOAuth
methods.description: Initializes OAuth-related routes and handlers for the API.

methods.name: createOAuthApp
methods.description: Handles creation of a new OAuth application.

methods.name: updateOAuthApp
methods.description: Handles updating an existing OAuth application.

methods.name: getOAuthApps
methods.description: Retrieves list of OAuth applications, with permission checks.

methods.name: getOAuthApp
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific OAuth application.

methods.name: getOAuthAppInfo
methods.description: Retrieves sanitized info of an OAuth application.

methods.name: regenerateOAuthAppSecret
methods.description: Regenerates secret for an OAuth application, with checks for public clients.

methods.name: getAuthorizedOAuthApps
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth apps authorized for a user.

methods.name: registerOAuthClient
methods.description: Handles dynamic client registration (DCR) for external clients, with validation and allowlist enforcement.
